response.sql: WITH acct_avg AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount FROM account a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_avg AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amount) AS figure FROM acct_avg GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS overall_avg FROM region_avg), above_regions AS (SELECT r.region, r.figure FROM region_avg r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.figure > o.overall_avg), above_avg AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS above_avg FROM above_regions) SELECT ar.region, ar.figure, ar.figure - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall, ar.figure / aa.above_avg AS ratio_to_above_avg FROM above_regions ar CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN above_avg aa ORDER BY ar.region

assumptions.assumption: Accounts with no transactions are excluded, because they have no transaction average to contribute (inner join on trans).

trans.amount is averaged as stored (unsigned magnitudes), ignoring trans.type. The request says to average trans.amount, and the verified notes say direction is carried by type, including the undocumented VYBER rows.

Each region figure is the unweighted mean of its accounts' averages, the all-region average is the unweighted mean of the region figures, and the above-average comparison uses the unweighted mean of the above-average region figures. This follows the request's wording.

alternatives.interpretation: Signed amounts: credits (PRIJEM) count as positive and withdrawals (VYDAJ) as negative, so each account's average is a net-direction average. VYBER rows have no documented direction and are left out (NULL, skipped by AVG). Accounts whose transactions are all VYBER drop out.
alternatives.sql: WITH acct_avg AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE t.type WHEN 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_amount FROM account a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_avg AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amount) AS figure FROM acct_avg GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS overall_avg FROM region_avg), above_regions AS (SELECT r.region, r.figure FROM region_avg r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.figure > o.overall_avg), above_avg AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS above_avg FROM above_regions) SELECT ar.region, ar.figure, ar.figure - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall, ar.figure / aa.above_avg AS ratio_to_above_avg FROM above_regions ar CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN above_avg aa ORDER BY ar.region
